Bill.BriefDescription: Creating additional district court judge positions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to district court judges; amending RCW 3.34.010;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 3.34.010 and 2003 c 97 s 1 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The number of district judges to be elected in each county shallbe: Adams, two; Asotin, one; Benton, three; Chelan, two; Clallam, two;Clark, six; Columbia, one; Cowlitz, two; Douglas, one; Ferry, one;Franklin, one; Garfield, one; Grant, two; Grays Harbor, two; Island,one; Jefferson, one; King, twentyone; Kitsap, ((three)) four;Kittitas, two; Klickitat, two; Lewis, two; Lincoln, one; Mason, one;Okanogan, two; Pacific, two; Pend Oreille, one; Pierce, eleven; SanJuan, one; Skagit, two; Skamania, one; Snohomish, eight; Spokane, ten;Stevens, one; Thurston, ((two)) three; Wahkiakum, one; Walla Walla,two; Whatcom, two; Whitman, one; Yakima, four. This number may beincreased only as provided in RCW 3.34.020.
For the purposes of RCW 3.34.025, the p. 1 HB 1202district judge position for Clark county created in chapter 97, Laws of2003, is hereby recreated as of the effective date of this section.
